content.title: Luka Doncic confirms divorce with his fiancé, issues statement
content.text: The Lakers superstar is now on a custody battle for their two young daughters. Luka Doncic has separated from his partner and is now facing a custody battle for their two daughters. Luka Doncic MIN: 35.51 PTS: 32.54 (56.91%) REB: 7.81 AS: 8.38 ST: 1.48 BL: 0.52 TO: 4.04 GM: 52 In a statement to ESPN, the Los Angeles Lakers superstar dropped the revelation. "I love my daughters more than anything and I've been doing everything I can for them to be with me in the U.S. during the season, but that hasn't been possible, so I recently made the tough decision to end my engagement," Doncic said. "Everything I do is for my daughters' happiness and I will always fight to be with them and give them the best life I can." TMZ first broke the news that Anamaria Goltes has filed a child support and attorney fees request to the court on Doncic. The Slovenian sensation has no idea about it as the filing was made in California, where his first daughter was with him for only three months and the youngest hasn't been to the U.S. As such, ESPN reported that Doncic has fully provided for his family and is paying his daughters' expenses "without limitation." Doncic and Goltes began their relationship in 2016, with the NBA superstar proposing on July 7, 2023. The couple later welcomed Gabriela on Nov. 30, followed by the birth of Olivia two years later on Dec. 4, 2025, in which the Lakers sensation missed two games as he visited his youngest daughter in Slovenia. Disagreement ensued between him and Goltes, as his former partner called the police. Arriving officers tending to the matter "did not detect any elements of a criminal offense or misdemeanor" around the Slovenian star. Doncic flew back to America peacefully and hasn't seen Goltes and his two daughters since. Sources told ESPN that Doncic filed an interim injunction with Slovenian courts on Feb. 26 seeking immediate contact with Gabriela and Olivia. The sudden disappearance of Doncic's images on the Instagram account of Goltes fueled speculations that the two are not on good terms. Leading the Lakers (39-25) to the fifth-best record in the West heading to Tuesday's matchup against the Minnesota Timberwolves, Doncic is averaging an NBA-high 32.5 points with 8.4 assists, 7.8 rebounds and 1.5 steals in 52 games this season for LA.
